title: Everything We Do Is About Love
speaker: Ryushin Andrea Thach
summary: Ryushin Andrea Thach's talk emphasizes that true peace and understanding come from embracing love and compassion as fundamental aspects of Zen practice. This involves letting go of ego and seeing ourselves and others as part of a larger, interconnected universe, rather than separate entities. By cultivating this sense of unity and acceptance, we can respond to difficult times with kindness and understanding, rather than hatred or division, and live our lives with greater awareness and connection to the world around us.
